/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
profile_dir="$HOME/.thunderbird/t5q2a5hp.default-release/Mail/Local Folders"

  if [ ! -e "$profile_dir/$folder" ]; then
    install -m 600 /dev/null "$profile_dir/$folder"

    mkdir -m 700 "$profile_dir/$folder.sbd"
  fi
done
ls -la "$profile_dir" | sed -n '"'/COMPANY\\|UNIVERSITY/p'"

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
pkill -TERM thunderbird || true
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  if ! pgrep -x thunderbird >/dev/null; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 0.5
done
if pgrep -x thunderbird >/dev/null; then
  pkill -KILL thunderbird || true
  sleep 1
fi
(thunderbird >/tmp/thunderbird-restart.log 2>&1 &)
sleep 2
pgrep -a thunderbird || true'
